messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference for the **federal public holidays** that create long‑weekend opportunities across Canada in 2023 (i.e., holidays that fall on a weekday and therefore give you an extra day off).  
(If you’re interested in provincial/territorial holidays as well, let me know and I’ll add those.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Type |
|---------|-------------|--------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sun | Weekend only (no extra day) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, PEI) | Feb 20 | Mon | Creates a long weekend (Mon–Wed) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Fri | Creates a long weekend (Fri–Sun) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Mon | Creates a long weekend (Mon–Tue) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Tue | Creates a long weekend (Mon–Tue) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Mon | Creates a long weekend (Mon–Tue) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Mon | Creates a long weekend (Mon–Tue) |
| Remembrance Day (observed) | Nov 11 | Wed | No long weekend (falls mid‑week) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Mon | Creates a long weekend (Mon–Tue) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tue | Creates a long weekend (Mon–Tue) |

### Quick Takeaway
- **Long weekends** (with at least one paid day off plus the weekend) in 2023 will be available on:
  - **Feb 20** (Family Day – BC, AB, SK, NB, PEI)
  - **Apr 7** (Good Friday)
  - **May 22** (Victoria Day)
  - **Jul 1** (Canada Day)
  - **Sep 4** (Labour Day)
  - **Oct 9** (Thanksgiving)
  - **Dec 25** (Christmas Day)

These are the federal holidays that line up with weekdays and give you a natural break. If you’d like the full list including provincial holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in Manitoba, etc.) or want them formatted for your app’s calendar integration, just let me know!
